mapper.select: -- file name: NationInfoMapper.xml -- query id: getNationInfo with cte_nation_and_sub_dvsn as materialized ( select a.nat_info_no , a.nat_area_cd , a.nat_cd , a.nat_nm , a.nat_ko_nm , a.latud , a.lngtud , b.sub_dvsn_no , b.sub_dvsn_cd , b.sub_dvsn_nm , b.sub_dvsn_ko_nm from nation_info as a inner join nation_sub_dvsn_info as b on a.nat_info_no = b.nat_info_no where a.use_yn = 'Y' and b.use_yn = 'Y' and a.nat_area_cd is not null ) select a.nat_info_no as nation_info_no , a.nat_cd as nation_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then a.nat_ko_nm else a.nat_nm end as nation_name , a.latud as latitude , a.lngtud as longitude , b.comm_cd as area_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then cond_1_val else comm_cd_nm end as area_name , a.sub_dvsn_no as nation_region_no , a.sub_dvsn_cd as nation_region_code , case when coalesce(#{lang},'en') = 'ko' then a.sub_dvsn_ko_nm else sub_dvsn_nm end as nation_region_name , case when c.country_no is null then 0 else 1 end as is_participating from cte_nation_and_sub_dvsn as a inner join comm_cd as b on a.nat_area_cd = b.comm_cd and b.comm_grp_cd = 'CM009' and b.use_yn = 'Y' left outer join ( select country_no from gmcs_test_monthly where target_system_code = 'GMCS' group by country_no ) as c on c.country_no = a.nat_info_no where 1 = 1 ;
